links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy and kappa of AI headache model on prospective external multicenter cohort
links.effect: Overall accuracy 94.92%, kappa 0.65 (95%CI 0.21-1.00); migraine specificity 66.67%; two disagreements with specialists among 59 patients; small sample with wide uncertainty.
links.quote: The models' overall accuracy and kappa for the ground truth were 94.92% and 0.65 (95%CI 0.21-1.00), respectively.

screen.reason: Multicenter prospective external validation of a previously developed AI-based diagnostic model for headache disorders, but it only evaluates standalone model accuracy without testing specific deployment safeguards or clinical workflows.
